About.title: The people who build it
About.intro: Shree Shakti is a mandap, sound and decoration contractor working out of Surendranagar. We own what we put up, we crew what we run, and we are on site while your function is happening.
About.storyBody: The full story is being written for this page — ask us on WhatsApp in the meantime and we will tell it properly.
About.storyPending: This section is waiting on the founder’s own words rather than something written for him.
About.v1Body: Structures, sound, lighting and furniture are ours, kept in our godown and counted before every load. Nothing about your date depends on another supplier releasing stock.
About.v2Title: We quote after seeing the ground
About.v2Body: A number given over the phone is a guess, and guesses go wrong on setup day. Every quote follows a site visit and lists what it covers, line by line.
About.v3Body: The people who built the setup are on site while it is being used. A drape slips, a mic needs raising, a light needs moving — somebody is there, and you do not have to find them.
About.v4Title: We say when something will not work
About.v4Body: If the ground cannot take the structure, or the budget will not carry the idea, we say so before you book rather than after. That has cost us work and kept us clients.
About.v5Body: The removal day is agreed when you book. The venue goes back on time and you are not chasing anyone the morning after.
About.v6Body: Waterproof, wind-rated covers, cabling clear of standing water, and the counters and sound position covered first when a forecast turns.
About.crewBody: Structure teams, sound engineers, lighting crew, decorators and drivers. Photographs and names are being added — ask and we will tell you who will be on your site.
